tei:div.tei:p: 58) 59)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi cha lag bskang ba shel gyi me long bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye:

rang rig rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams tshogs chen gsog pa'i thabs: bskang ba shel gyi me long bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: snyan yi dbyangs dang thod rnga'i sgras: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ: snang ba'i dngos po ma lus kun: āḥ ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: hūm̐: phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin chen po: rab 'byams zhing kun yongs khyab gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum dang: mchod pa'i sprin gzungs brjod la: bskang ba dngos ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings mkha' ltar khyab pa'i zhing khams nas: lhun grub rang gdangs sku gsum zhi dang khro: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas: bskang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su sol: padma nyi zla bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: sku gsum zhi dang khro bo'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: sku gsum 60)ye shes dngos grub stsol: rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang: phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol: sbyor sgrol yum gyi= bde stong ye shes dngos= kī la rigs bzhi'i thugs= las bzhi lhun grub= khro bcu yab yum= drag po mthu yi= sgo ma bzhi yi= tshad med rnam bzhi'i= dam can ma mo'i= las rnams thogs med= ging dang pho nya'i thugs= dgra bgegs 'gugs bsgral phrin las mdzod: gter srung dam can= zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa dang: bstan 'dzin tshe srings dngos grub stsol: khyad par thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas: drag po'i 'dod yon rnam lnga dang: dza gad bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: māṃ pa'i lhun po dpang re mtho: bza' dang bca' dang btung ba sogs: 'dod yon sna tshogs ri ltar spungs: rgya che grangs mang bkod legs pa: sku gsum zhi dang khro bo'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: sku gsum ye shes dngos grub stsol:

rdo rje gzhon nu'i= phyag rgya chen po'i= sbyor sgrol yum chen= bde stong ye shes= kī la rigs bzhi'i= las bzhi lhun grub= khro bcu yab yum= drag po mthu yi= sgo ma bzhi yi= tshad med rnam bzhi'i= dam can ma 61)mo'i= las rnams thogs med= ging dang pho nya'i= dgra bgegs 'gugs bsgral phrin las mdzod: gter srung dam can= zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa dang: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lta ba mtha' bral klong du bskang: sgom pa zang thal chen por bskang: spyod pa spang blang med par bskang: 'bras bu ye rdzogs chen por bskang: bskang dang bskang bya las 'das pa: rang grol chos dbyings klong du āḥ ho: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs: bdag cag ma rig rkyen dbang gis: dam pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la: ma dad log par lta ba bshags: dam tshig gcig pa'i spun sring la: dgra gnyen chags sdang bgyis pa= dbang skur zab mo thob byas nas: rtsa gsum bsgom bzlas g.yel ba= snang srid dag pa rab 'byams la: 'khor 'das gnyis su 'dzin pa= snang ba lha dang lha mo'i zhing: bzang ngan phyogs su bltas pa= lta ba mtha' dbus bral ba la: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul par 'phyan pa= sgom pa gting gsal ye shes la: 'og 'gyu dran med dub pa bshags: spyod pa kun tu 62)bzang po la: dgag sgrub blang dor byas pa= 'bras bu mnyam nyid chos sku'i klong: blo yis gtad so byas pa= mdor na sgo gsum bag med pas: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad sdom: dag tshangs sor chud dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ āḥ zhes tshang bar brjod: 'di nyid nyams su blangs gyur na: dam tshig nyams chags kun byang nas: tshe 'dir don gnyis dngos grub thob: the tshom med do sa ma ya: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can dang 'di ma 'phrad: sa ma ya: zab rgya:
gsang rgya: gter rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang ser dgon dben gnas 'od gsal dga' ba'i ljongs nas snyoms las pa kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bgyis pa'o// dge'o//
